integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically from the source's exact one-step formula and its proof that first homology is preserved. No finite enumeration or computational extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the homology-preserving Seifert iteration printed in the source. It does not classify all fixed-homology Seifert presentations, and it does not assert pairwise coprimality among the original exceptional-fiber orders.
title: Sylvester-type arithmetic in the fixed-homology Seifert tower
